batch-functions.composition: Oracle counts every function-like node (function/method/arrow/function-expression/generator); the producer emits one fact only for a function whose span holds a `.batch(`/`.transaction(` call. Residual = the large majority of functions that hold no batch/transaction call.

code-block.composition: Oracle counts block nodes (functions/classes/control-flow) plus `object`/`call_expression` fragment nodes; the producer projects DRY blocks and fragments with dedup and a declared-value filter. Residual = object literals and call expressions outside a declared value, plus the dedup of methods emitted through both the function and class walks.

cross-language-entities.composition: Oracle counts entity-declaring nodes (function/method/arrow/interface, Go `type_spec`); the producer projects named entities, folding methods/arrows into their containing entity and emitting a Go `type_spec` only when it declares a struct/interface. Residual = folded members and non-entity type declarations.

data-access-calls-candidates.composition: Oracle counts `call_expression` + `template_string` nodes; the producer emits one raw, provenance-free candidate per query-shaped call (the extract half of the `data-access-calls` collapse — the handle verdict, injection gate, and per-site SQL parse are re-folded corpus-side once the `receiver-provenance` fixed point supplies the seed). Residual = the large majority of calls/templates that are not DB/ORM-shaped.

ddl-declarations.composition: Oracle counts op-producing DDL statements off source text — CREATE/DROP/ALTER-RENAME TABLE headers only (an ALTER TABLE … ADD/DROP/ALTER COLUMN / ADD CONSTRAINT header is a column/constraint change recorded in `tableColumns`, not an op, so the oracle does not count it). The producer emits one op per CREATE (incl. the FTS5 `CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE` recovery), one per DROP target, and one per `ALTER TABLE … RENAME TO` parsed by `parseMigrationOps` under the corpus's detected dialect (Spec 70 R1 threads `detectDialect`). A null-dialect corpus (hhra-org ambiguous pg+mysql, blitz and openstatus no driver) abstains — `parseMigrationOps` no longer guesses sqlite, so its DDL emits zero ops and the whole header count is a `cannot-fire` population, not an under-emission. The only real residual is recall-protocol (sqlite via a D1 binding): 12 op-producing statements across 6 files that node-sql-parser rejects (valid sqlite the grammar cannot parse). See `specs/known-issues.md` §ddl-declarations.

dynamic-sql.composition: Oracle counts `query(`/`execute(` call sites off source text; the producer emits one candidate only for the dangerous `${…}`/`+` forms that survive the parameterized-query and taint-safety filters. Residual = safe/parameterized query/execute calls.

export-form.composition: Oracle counts `export_statement` nodes; the producer emits one `(name, isDefault)` fact per statement `extractExports` can name (the first named export of a multi-name clause). Residual = namespace re-exports (`export * from '…'`) and empty clauses (`export {}`) that name nothing.

file-imports.composition: Oracle counts `import_statement` (TS/JS) and `import_spec` (Go) nodes; the producer's `imports` array is a deduped set. Residual = duplicate specifiers (a name imported more than once).

file-symbols.composition: Oracle counts function-like + class + interface declaration nodes; the producer folds methods into their class symbol. Residual = methods (and other members) riding on a class symbol.

function-index.composition: Oracle counts `function_declaration` + `arrow_function`; the producer emits an arrow only when bound to a variable declarator. Residual = bare callback arrows (legitimately skipped).

go-package-bindings.composition: Oracle counts package-scope declaration nodes (function/method/type_spec/var_spec); the producer emits one name-deduped binding per declaration. Residual = duplicate names — methods on different receivers share a bare method name (`String()`, `MarshalJSON()`), and a `var a, b, c` spec's identifier-list is a single binding.

import-form.composition: Oracle counts `import_statement` nodes; the producer re-runs a per-line source-text regex classifier (`parseFileImports`) that recognizes fewer forms. Residual = statements the classifier does not project (multi-line imports, `import type`, inline `{ type X }`).

loop-query-candidates.composition: Oracle counts loop nodes (for/for-in/while/do); the producer emits one raw candidate per loop whose body holds a DB-shaped call (the extract half of the `loop-queries` collapse — the strict-handle filter, per-loop dedup, and stable symbol are re-folded corpus-side once the `receiver-provenance` fixed point supplies the seed). Residual = loops whose body holds no DB-shaped call.

query-site-candidates.composition: Oracle counts every member call (`\.\w+(`) plus every SQL keyword occurrence (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) in the raw source; the producer emits one located site per recognized query mechanism (un-gated — the DB-context file gate and handle-ness are re-applied corpus-side once the `receiver-provenance` fixed point supplies the seed). Residual = member calls that are not query mechanisms and SQL keywords inside a recognized call body (which the located scan strips).

react-component.composition: Oracle counts `jsx_element` + `jsx_self_closing_element` nodes; the producer sums each component's `jsxElementDetails` (one per JSX occurrence, nested included). Residual = JSX that sits outside a component.

schema-usage-candidates.composition: Oracle counts `call_expression` + `string` + `template_string` nodes; the producer emits one candidate per provenance-free table reference (ORM / query-builder / collection-adapter), tagged-template candidate, or DB-call candidate — the extract half of the `schema-usage` collapse (the two provenance-dependent strategies are re-admitted corpus-side once the `receiver-provenance` fixed point supplies the seed). Residual = strings/calls/templates naming no table reference.

secret-candidates.composition: Oracle counts `string` + `template_string` nodes; the producer emits one candidate per credential-position string (declarator/assignment/pair/call). Residual = strings outside a credential position.

security-candidates.composition: Oracle counts `call_expression` + `template_string` nodes; the producer emits one candidate per shell call / computed-require / sink-reaching template. Residual = the large majority of calls/templates that are not security-relevant.

style-declarations.composition: Oracle counts every `declaration` node in the file; the producer projects only declarations inside a `rule_set` (and may expand a shorthand into several). Residual = declarations outside a rule_set (`@keyframes`/`@font-face`/`@page`), not shorthand expansion.

type-declarations.composition: Oracle counts Go `type_spec` nodes (exempting `*_test.go`); the producer emits only struct/interface type specs. Residual = non-struct/interface declarations (aliases, `func`/slice/map types).
